statement: If Burnol exhaustion residual is $\epsilon_B$ and Dirichlet-shadow defect is $\delta_{BD}$, then $\epsilon_{\rm hyb}\le \epsilon_B+\delta_{BD}$.
Finite residual absorption promotes only with residual tail $T_{R,N}$ and fixed/exhaustive ledger control.
If $\epsilon_B+\delta_{BD}\not<1$ or $\ker R_N\ne0$, the missed sector is a $\Xi$-adequacy residual, not a proof.
